summary: Frontend-only verification of the Cyber Risk 'Financial basis & benchmark' panel with the new Industry Auto-Detect suggest button. Logged in as admin, navigated to /app/cyber-risk, verified all required data-testid elements render, exercised the industry select and fin-industry-suggest flow, and reset industry back to Technology for demo consistency. All pass, no console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: CyberRisk.jsx FinancialBasis component ~150 lines lives inline in the same file as CyberRisk page — consider extracting to its own file for maintainability; file is still under 300 lines so not blocking.

load() Promise.all catches with a bare .catch(() => {}) which silently swallows errors from /financial/basis and /financial/config, potentially hiding failures behind a blank panel (component returns null if basis or cfg unset). Consider adding a lightweight error state.
industry select onChange fires save on every change — no debounce needed here since it's a select, but note the same-file records/perrecord inputs use onBlur which is correct.
